primitives.name: Intelligent Feedback Loop
primitives.verbatim_quote: 212 WINNING FOOTBALL a team to listen intelligently to criticism and suggestion directed at play and to whatever emotional stimulus seems advisable.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T': 'team performance index (dimensionless)', 'C': 'coach feedback intensity (arbitrary units)', 'E': 'emotional stimulus magnitude (arbitrary units)'}
primitives.assumptions: Feedback is processed in real-time; emotional stimuli are quantifiable and adaptive.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When feedback delay exceeds threshold T > 0.5, performance degradation occurs.

layer2.mapping: Feedback loop mirrors Bayesian updating process where T(t+1) = f(C(t), E(t))

primitives.name: Coach Awareness Advantage
primitives.verbatim_quote: It helps a team amazingly to discover that their coach is fiendishly aware of minor happenings on the field and they play better after finding it out, every time.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A': 'coach awareness level (dimensionless)', 'P': 'player performance gain (percentage points)', 'F': 'field observation fidelity (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Player perception of coach knowledge directly correlates with performance improvement.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When A < 0.7, P drops below baseline performance.

layer2.mapping: A = g(F) implies P = h(A) via psychological reinforcement model
layer2.telemetry: Player self-report confidence levels post-coach revelation

primitives.name: Halftime Rest Optimization
primitives.verbatim_quote: I know that some men have experimented with the alternative of keeping the team on the field between the halves, and although this has the one advantage of making sure that they are not breathing bad air, I think it never pays.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R': 'rest interval duration (seconds)', 'S': 'player stiffness index (dimensionless)', 'B': 'breathing quality indicator (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Rest intervals must balance physical recovery and mental refreshment.
primitives.breakdown_regime: For R < 300s, S increases exponentially; B remains stable above 0.8.

layer2.telemetry: Physiological stress markers and cognitive test scores pre/post rest

Coach awareness advantage leverages trust and perception to enhance efficacy, while halftime optimization ensures physiological readiness. These interact as a closed-loop system: feedback → awareness → rest → re-evaluation. Failure modes include delayed feedback leading to misalignment, low coach visibility causing disengagement, and inadequate rest resulting in fatigue-induced errors. Each primitive operates under bounded rationality constraints but collectively support emergent tactical intelligence.
